task_summary: Patched the verification skill with a bounded Windows Vitest temporary-directory and MongoMemoryServer loopback recovery path.

skills_patched.name: verification-loop
skills_patched.change: Added workspace-local TEMP/TMP recovery for Vitest cache rename EPERM, isolated approved localhost access for MongoMemoryServer EACCES, and per-suite watchdog guidance.

key_decisions: Keep each server test suite isolated when a grouped run shows no progress and reaches the 120-second watchdog.
Never connect an isolated test to or mutate the running app database.
lessons_learned: In this Windows sandbox, a targeted server suite first failed before tests with EPERM in OS temp, then with EACCES to its MongoMemoryServer loopback socket; a workspace-local test temp path and approved isolated loopback run resolved both environment failures.
Running the slow server gate files as a combined command exceeded 120 seconds without test output, while each isolated suite completed within the watchdog.
